interest_descriptions.History & Architecture 🏰: Explore Timișoara’s baroque squares, grand palaces, Orthodox and Catholic cathedrals, and a rich blend of architectural styles.
interest_descriptions.Art & Culture 🎨: Visit major art museums, cultural buildings, street-art zones and creative local galleries.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Relax in Timișoara’s famous parks, rose gardens, tree-lined promenades and peaceful green corners.
interest_descriptions.Cafés & Local Life ☕: Experience cozy cafés, student-friendly districts and vibrant everyday city life.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Taste Banat specialties, pastries, soups, stews and many vegetarian-friendly dishes.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Capture colorful squares, baroque façades, river reflections and elegant historical details.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Traditional Banat dishes such as vegetable stews, soups, pastries and mild, comforting meals.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Pastry shops, sandwiches, quick bites and simple old-town street-food options.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Soups, salads, stews, pasta dishes and light plant-friendly meals widely available.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: A flexible combination of local Banat meals, international dishes and vegetarian alternatives.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Union Square (Piața Unirii): Start your day in Timișoara’s most iconic square — pastel colors everywhere, baroque palaces glowing in the morning light, and a big open space that immediately puts you in a good mood. → | ⛪ St. George's Cathedral: Step inside for warm colors, elegant details and a peaceful atmosphere that feels like a soft morning reset. → | 🏰 Baroque Palace (Museum of Art): Wander through classy halls filled with both classical and modern pieces — artsy, calm and inspiring. → | ☕ Librarium Café: A cozy book-themed café perfect for a slow morning drink surrounded by warm wooden shelves and calm vibes.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏛️ Victory Square (Piața Victoriei): A grand boulevard-style square with fountains, gardens and vibrant façades — great for walking, people-watching and soaking in the atmosphere. → | 🎭 Romanian Opera House: Beautiful architecture and a major cultural landmark — one of those buildings that makes you stop for a photo even if you didn’t plan to. → | 🌹 Roses Park: A local favorite — endless rose varieties, leafy paths, shadows to rest in and that soft, quiet charm. → | 🍽️ Banat-Style Lunch: Hearty soups, vegetable stews, pastries, noodles, light veggie dishes — comforting flavors with a homemade feel.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Bega River Promenade: The river glows, the paths get calm, and the reflections turn golden — a peaceful, photogenic and slow-motion kind of sunset spot.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Riverside Cafés & Dessert Spots (non-alcoholic): Warm lights along the Bega, cozy student-friendly cafés, dessert places, and an easy evening vibe perfect for strolling and unwinding.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Union Square → St. George’s Cathedral → Baroque Palace (Art Museum) → Librarium Café.; Afternoon: Victory Square → Romanian Opera House → Roses Park → Banat lunch.; Sunset: Bega River golden reflections.; Night: Riverside desserts + relaxed evening walk.

interest_descriptions.History & Fortresses 🏰: Explore one of Romania’s most important historical strongholds — Alba Carolina, a massive star-shaped fortress full of monumental gates, bastions and centuries of heritage.
interest_descriptions.Architecture & Monuments 🏛️: Walk through elegant squares, ceremonial gates, cathedrals and beautifully restored baroque and neo-Romanesque structures.
interest_descriptions.Museums & Culture 🎨: Discover exhibitions about Transylvanian history, archaeology, royal heritage and local cultural traditions.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Enjoy peaceful fortress gardens, shady walking paths, green lawns and relaxing open spaces within and around the citadel.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Taste Transylvanian soups, dumplings, stews, pastries and vegetarian-friendly regional meals.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Capture massive fortress walls, Roman ruins, ceremonial gates, sunset-lit bastions and atmospheric old-town corners.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Alba Carolina Fortress: Start the day in one of Eastern Europe’s most impressive star-shaped citadels — massive gates, dramatic bastions and that epic ‘walking through centuries’ feeling. Perfect for exploring at a chill pace. → | 🏛️ Union Hall: Step into the elegant building where Romania’s Great Union was proclaimed — bright interiors, historical markers and a calm, respectful vibe. → | 🏺 Roman Castrum Gates: Check out reconstructed Roman gates and archaeological remains from ancient Apulum — a cool time-travel contrast right inside the fortress. → | ☕ Fortress Courtyard Café: Take a relaxing break in a cozy courtyard café surrounded by old stone walls and quiet morning air.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ Coronation Cathedral: Beautiful Neo-Romanesque architecture, peaceful courtyards and soft interior light — a symbol of Romanian royalty and national history. → | 🖼️ National Museum of the Union: Dive into archaeology, ethnography, old maps, Roman artifacts and Transylvanian heritage — lots to see, but easy to enjoy at your own pace. → | 🍽️ Transylvanian Lunch: Warm soups, hearty stews, dumplings, pastries and veggie-friendly dishes — comforting, homey and full of regional flavor.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Fortress Bastion Walk: Golden hour hits differently here — warm light along the fortress walls, panoramic edges of the city and a super calm, cinematic atmosphere.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old-Town Cafés & Illuminated Fortress Walk: Dessert spots glowing softly, beautifully lit stone alleys, peaceful night paths and that magical quiet you only get in historic citadels.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Alba Carolina Fortress → Union Hall → Roman Gates → Courtyard café.; Afternoon: Coronation Cathedral → National Museum of the Union → Transylvanian lunch.; Sunset: Bastion golden hour walk.; Night: Dessert cafés + illuminated fortress alleys.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Unirii Square: Start your day in Cluj’s big, bright central square — full of history, gorgeous façades and early-morning calm before the city wakes up. → | ⛪ St. Michael's Church: A Gothic landmark with soaring towers and a dramatic interior — one of the tallest church towers in Romania. → | 🗿 Matthias Corvinus Statue: Iconic monument of the medieval king born right here — a classic Cluj photo spot. → | ☕ Central Café Break: Grab a relaxing coffee in a stylish, student-friendly café buzzing with soft morning energy.
tour_type.afternoon: 🚶 Old Town Walk: Wander pastel façades, tiny bookstores, artistic corners and cozy streets — Cluj’s old town is full of gentle color and youth culture. → | 🏺 National Museum of Transylvanian History: Dive into archaeology, medieval exhibits, and regional stories that bring Transylvania’s past to life. → | 🌳 Botanical Garden: Palm houses, tropical plants, a Japanese garden, ponds and shaded paths — one of the calmest, prettiest spots in the whole city. → | 🍽️ Transylvanian Lunch: Soups, sarmale, papanași (fried dough + cream + jam = joy), plus vegetarian-friendly dishes — comforting and delicious.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Cetățuia Hill Lookout: Walk or take a short climb up to catch the city glowing under golden-hour light — rooftops, towers, university buildings and the soft evening sky.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Student District Cafés & Dessert Spots (non-alcoholic): Cluj’s student scene = warm lights, friendly cafés, dessert places, and a relaxed, youthful vibe perfect for safe and cozy evening wandering.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Unirii Square → St. Michael’s Church → Matthias Corvinus Statue → Central café.; Afternoon: Old Town walk → History Museum → Botanical Garden → Transylvanian lunch.; Sunset: Cetățuia Hill golden-hour view.; Night: Student-district dessert cafés & relaxed evening stroll.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Large Square (Piața Mare): Begin your Sibiu day in the grand medieval heart of the city — colorful façades, open space, and those charming rooftops with 'eyes' watching you 👀 (Sibiu classic!). → | 🏰 Brukenthal Palace & Art Museum: Elegant Baroque palace with impressive art collections — classy, calm and full of history. → | 🔭 Council Tower Viewpoint: Climb up for those iconic Sibiu roof views — red tiles, medieval streets, distant hills… pure Transylvanian magic. → | ☕ Piața Mică Café Break: Cozy terrace, medieval arches, warm morning atmosphere — perfect spot to charge up.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏘️ Bridge of Lies & Small Square: Wander photogenic corners, colorful houses and the legendary Bridge of Lies — a fun little must-see. → | 🏺 History Museum: Explore local heritage inside a beautifully preserved historic building — medieval items, artifacts and cultural stories. → | 🌿 Sub Arini Park Walk: One of Romania’s oldest parks — shady paths, fresh air, peaceful greenery… the ideal mid-day reset. → | 🍽️ Transylvanian Lunch: Hearty soups, stews, pastries, dumplings and veggie-friendly options — comforting dishes with classic regional flavor.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Citadel Walls & Bastions: Golden hour reflecting off medieval fortifications — peaceful paths, towers glowing softly and a calm end-of-day atmosphere.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old Town Cafés & Dessert Spots: Warm lights, cobblestone streets, safe and lively student-friendly corners — perfect for pastries, hot drinks and a relaxed nighttime wander.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Union Square (Piața Unirii): Begin your day in Oradea’s vibrant heart — colorful Art Nouveau buildings, elegant palaces and that crisp early-morning light bouncing off pastel façades. Easy walk, big charm. → | 🏰 Black Eagle Palace: Step inside this gorgeous glass-roofed arcade — mosaics, decorative ironwork and endless photo-perfect corners. It’s like walking through a stylish time capsule. → | 🕍 Moon Church: Calm interior + a super unique astronomical mechanism that tracks lunar phases — a little scientific surprise in the middle of town. → | ☕ Art Nouveau Quarter Café: Cozy, stylish café break with pastel interiors and that “slow morning is the best morning” vibe.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏯 Oradea Fortress: Explore the star-shaped citadel — open courtyards, small museums, exhibitions and big walkable spaces that feel both historic and relaxing. → | 🌆 Crișul Repede Riverside Walk: Breezy river paths, decorative bridges and leafy promenades — perfect for an easygoing afternoon stroll with calming water sounds. → | 🍽️ Traditional Bihor Lunch: Soups, dumplings, pastries, veggie-friendly plates and mild regional flavors — warm, tasty, comforting.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Rooftop View (Old Town): Head up to a rooftop viewpoint for golden reflections across the river and glowing Art Nouveau rooftops — one of Oradea’s most beautiful sunset scenes.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Riverside Cafés & Dessert Spots (non-alcoholic): Soft modern lights along the water, cozy dessert cafés, friendly evening atmosphere — safe, calm and perfect for unwinding with something sweet.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Union Square → Black Eagle Palace → Moon Church → Art Nouveau café.; Afternoon: Oradea Fortress → Crișul Repede walk → Traditional Bihor lunch.; Sunset: Rooftop golden-hour views.; Night: Riverside dessert cafés & relaxed evening stroll.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Palace of Culture: Start big — Iași’s iconic neo-gothic palace with tall towers, ornate carvings and museum halls that feel like you accidentally walked into a fantasy movie set. So photogenic it’s unfair. → | ⛪ Metropolitan Cathedral: Bright domes, soft interior light and a peaceful atmosphere right in the heart of the city — calm and impressive at the same time. → | 🏛️ Union Square: Fountains, monuments, elegant buildings and wide walkways made for an easy, relaxed morning stroll. → | ☕ Central Café Break: Student-friendly café with warm drinks and a laid-back “uni city morning” vibe.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌿 Copou Park: Romania’s oldest public park — leafy paths, historic statues, benches in the shade and that gentle ‘I could walk here for hours’ feeling. → | 📚 Eminescu’s Linden Tree: Famous landmark tied to Romania’s most beloved poet — a quiet, symbolic place perfect for a short reflective pause. → | 🌳 Iași Botanical Garden: Huge and beautiful — lakes, themed gardens, tropical greenhouses and peaceful shady corners everywhere. Perfect afternoon escape. → | 🍽️ Moldavian Lunch: Think soups, sarmale, stews, plăcinte (super tasty pastries) and vegetarian-friendly options — warm, homey and full of local flavor.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Copou Hill: Golden-hour glow over old university buildings, long historic boulevards and leafy scenery — peaceful, atmospheric and very Iași.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Student District Cafés & Dessert Spots (non-alcoholic): Cozy cafés, modern dessert corners, bookish atmospheres, friendly students everywhere and a safe, relaxed vibe ideal for an evening wander.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Palace of Culture → Metropolitan Cathedral → Union Square → Central café.; Afternoon: Copou Park → Eminescu’s Linden Tree → Botanical Garden → Moldavian lunch.; Sunset: Copou Hill golden-hour.; Night: Student-district dessert cafés & chill evening walk.

tour_type.morning: 🎡 Casino Promenade: Start strong at Constanța’s superstar landmark — the elegant, slightly dramatic seafront Casino. Morning light hits it perfectly, making the whole area feel like the opening scene of a movie. → | 🌊 Sea Cliff Walk: Follow the coastline along rocky edges, blue waves and that refreshing Black Sea breeze that resets your soul instantly. → | 🏛️ Roman Mosaic Edifice: Step inside this huge archaeological site — ancient Roman floors, mosaics and ruins that show off just how long this city’s been around. → | ☕ Seafront Café: Grab a slow coffee break with coastal air, soft waves and calm morning energy.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏺 Archaeology Museum & Ovid Square: Roman statues, mosaics, artifacts and a charming square named after the famous poet who once lived here — history everywhere, but in a relaxed, open-air way. → | 🕌 Carol I Mosque (exterior or tower): Beautiful architecture, elegant lines and, if open, a tower climb with panoramic sea-meets-city views. → | 🏖️ Mamaia Beach Walk: Long sandy stretches, calm waves and warm sunshine — perfect for walking, chilling or taking breezy seaside photos. → | 🍽️ Seafood Lunch: Fresh fish dishes, soups, grilled plates and veggie-friendly options — coastal comfort food at its finest.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Casino Waterfront: When golden hour hits the waves, the Casino silhouette becomes pure art — glowing water, dramatic outlines and a calm, cinematic seaside atmosphere.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Seaside Dessert Bars & Ice-Cream Walks: Modern cafés, soft lights, gentle breeze and safe evening strolls along the seafront — perfect way to end the day with something sweet and relaxed.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Casino Promenade → Sea Cliff Walk → Roman Mosaic Edifice → Seaside café.; Afternoon: Archaeology Museum & Ovid Square → Carol I Mosque → Mamaia Beach walk → Seafood lunch.; Sunset: Casino Waterfront glow.; Night: Dessert bars + peaceful seaside stroll.
